entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly help you with a return. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with your item?

It's the new helmet I ordered. The color is just... it's not what I expected at all from the website. It looked like a vibrant red, but it's more of a dull orange. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.

I understand, that can definitely be frustrating when the shade isn't quite right. Just to clarify, is the issue a preference with the color, or do you believe there's a technical fault with the helmet itself?

Oh no, there's no fault. I'm sure the safety is excellent, that's why I always shop with you. It's just the color. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for this. To be honest, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to be perfect. I feel bad even asking.
Please don't feel bad at all, that's what we're here for. Let me just pull up your account and the policy for that item... One moment.

Okay, I see you're a long-time VeloFit VIP member, we really appreciate your business. And I have good news for you. The helmet is a standard item, and it falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you received it 29 days ago, you're unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. You've made my day.

Of course. I'm emailing a pre-paid return label to you right now. Just place that on the original shipping box and drop it at any post office. And as a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a 15% off coupon to your account for your next order. Perhaps you can find a different color you like better.
Wow, that's so generous of you, Charlie. Thank you so much for your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
